EmailTemplate.subject: Exciting Chance for Donors to Win BIG!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Your blood drive is coming up, and every donation is vital because hospital patients are counting on lifesaving blood products from your drive. We are grateful for your kindness and commitment to helping those in need.
As a special thank you to donors for helping address the need for blood during the critical post-holiday time, those who come to give Jan. 1-26, 2025, will be automatically entered for a chance to win a trip for two to Super Bowl LIX in New Orleans.^
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Share the attached email about this exciting incentive to recruit more blood donors! Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
All the best,
{!Lead.OwnerFirstName}
^NO PURCHASE OR DONATION NECESSARY. Void where prohibited and outside 50 U.S. and DC. Open to legal residents of 50 U.S. states and DC, age 18+ (19+ in NE and AL; 21+ in MS) at entry. Begins 12:00 AM ET on 01/01/25; ends 11:59 PM ET on 01/26/25. To enter, either present to donate blood at an American Red Cross blood donation facility or send an email to customercare@redcross.org and include the Giveaway name, "American Red Cross Super Bowl LIX Giveaway.” Limit of four (4) total Entries permitted per Entrant, regardless of method of entry. One (1) winner will receive one (1) trip for two (2) to attend Super Bowl LIX in New Orleans. ARV of all prizes: $9,500. Odds of winning depend on number of entries received. Full rules click here. Sponsor: American Red Cross. The prize shall not be sold on any internet site and any ticket that has been re-sold via the internet will be nullified. The National Football League’s licensed marks (“NFL”; “National Football League” and the NFL Shield design, “Super Bowl” and the Super Bowl LIX name) on any giveaway related materials have been reviewed by NFL and are used with permission. The NFL Entities have not offered or sponsored this giveaway in any way.
